-- Get sales by period and store
WITH period_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    f.store_key,
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 1 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
    AND s.store_id < 900  -- exclude web and special stores
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, f.store_key, s.store_id, s.store_name
),
-- Identify stores for LFL (those with sales in both years' period 1)
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id, store_name
  FROM period_sales
  GROUP BY store_id, store_name
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) = 2
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  fiscal_period,
  store_id,
  store_name,
  net_sales
FROM period_sales
WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, store_id

-- Calculate LFL growth for Period 1
WITH period_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    f.store_key,
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 1 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
    AND s.store_id < 900  -- exclude web and special stores
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, f.store_key, s.store_id, s.store_name
),
-- Identify stores for LFL (those with sales in both years' period 1)
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id, store_name
  FROM period_sales
  GROUP BY store_id, store_name
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) = 2
),
-- Get LFL sales by year
lfl_sales_by_year AS (
  SELECT 
    fiscal_year,
    SUM(net_sales) AS lfl_net_sales
  FROM period_sales
  WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
  GROUP BY fiscal_year
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  lfl_net_sales,
  LAG(lfl_net_sales) OVER (ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS prior_year_sales,
  ROUND((lfl_net_sales - LAG(lfl_net_sales) OVER (ORDER BY fiscal_year)) / LAG(lfl_net_sales) OVER (ORDER BY fiscal_year) * 100, 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales_by_year
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC

-- Like-for-like growth for period 1: FY2026/27 vs FY2025/26
WITH period_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    f.store_key,
    s.store_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 1 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, f.store_key, s.store_id
),
-- Stores present in both periods
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id
  FROM period_sales
  GROUP BY store_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) = 2
),
-- Aggregate by year
year_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    fiscal_year,
    SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales
  FROM period_sales
  WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
  GROUP BY fiscal_year
)
SELECT 
  ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END) - 
          MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END)) / 
         MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) * 100, 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM year_totals

-- Check store status for LFL universe
WITH period_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    f.store_key,
    s.store_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 1 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, f.store_key, s.store_id
),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id
  FROM period_sales
  GROUP BY store_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) = 2
)
SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  s.open_date,
  s.close_date,
  CASE WHEN s.close_date IS NULL THEN 'Open' ELSE 'Closed' END AS status
FROM dim_store s
WHERE s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
  AND s.is_current = TRUE
ORDER BY s.store_id
